models.name: Corolla
models.summary: A sensible, efficient compact sedan with a strong reputation for reliability.

review.verdict: An easy, efficient and dependable compact sedan that is cheap to own.

models.name: Civic
models.summary: The benchmark compact: refined, roomy and fun, now offered with a punchy hybrid.

review.verdict: Refined, roomy and genuinely enjoyable to drive, with a standout hybrid option.

models.name: Elantra
models.summary: Bold styling, a long warranty and a superb hybrid make it a smart value pick.

review.verdict: A feature-rich value champion, especially in frugal hybrid form.
pros: Lots of tech for the money

models.name: Camry
models.summary: Now hybrid-only, pairing outstanding efficiency with comfort and dependability.

review.verdict: A comfortable, frugal family sedan that is very hard to fault as an ownership proposition.
pros: Superb fuel economy across the range
cons: Rear headroom is tight for tall adults

models.name: Accord
models.summary: Spacious, polished and quick in hybrid form; one of the best family sedans available.

review.verdict: Big inside, polished on the road and brisk as a hybrid; a class leader.

models.name: Model 3
models.summary: Quick, efficient and loaded with tech, with access to the Supercharger network.

review.verdict: Quick, efficient and cheap to run, though the minimalist controls are not for everyone.
pros: Long range and rapid Supercharger access
cons: No Apple CarPlay or Android Auto
Nearly all controls on the touchscreen

models.name: Prius
models.summary: Now genuinely stylish and quick while still sipping fuel.

review.verdict: The Prius finally looks as good as its fuel economy figures.

models.name: Golf GTI
models.summary: The all-rounder hot hatch: fast, practical and fun every day.

image.author: Charles from Port Chester, New York

review.verdict: Still the hot hatch that does everything well, if you can live with the touch controls.

models.name: RAV4
models.summary: America's favorite SUV: practical, efficient and built to last.

review.verdict: Practical, frugal in hybrid form and famously durable; an easy recommendation.

models.name: CR-V
models.summary: Roomy, comfortable and refined; it nails the family SUV brief.

review.verdict: The most rounded compact SUV for families, especially as a hybrid.
pros: Cavernous rear seat and cargo hold

models.name: CX-5
models.summary: The driver's choice among compact SUVs, with a near-premium cabin.

review.verdict: Feels a class above in its cabin and on a winding road, at the cost of some space.
cons: Tight cargo space for the class

models.name: Tucson
models.summary: Feature-packed and practical, with a standout hybrid and a long warranty.

review.verdict: Lots of space, kit and warranty for the money; pick the hybrid.

models.name: Rogue
models.summary: Comfortable and well-equipped, if not the most exciting compact SUV.

review.verdict: A comfortable, well-equipped commuter that trails rivals on refinement and resale.

models.name: Model Y
models.summary: A practical, fast electric family SUV backed by a vast charging network.

review.verdict: Practical, quick and easy to charge on the road; the default electric family SUV.
pros: Huge cargo space with front trunk
cons: No Apple CarPlay or Android Auto

models.name: Ioniq 5
models.summary: Retro-futuristic style, ultra-fast charging and a roomy, lounge-like cabin.

review.verdict: Distinctive, spacious and among the fastest-charging EVs at its price.

models.name: Mustang Mach-E
models.summary: A genuinely fun-to-drive electric SUV with a tech-forward cabin.

review.verdict: One of the more engaging EVs to drive, held back by range and depreciation.

models.name: Telluride
models.summary: A stylish, near-luxury three-row SUV and one of the best family haulers.

review.verdict: Roomy, upscale and well priced; the three-row SUV to beat.
pros: Roomy for adults in all three rows

models.name: F-150
models.summary: The best-selling truck, with capability, comfort and an engine for every need.

review.verdict: Capable, comfortable and endlessly configurable; still the full-size benchmark.
cons: Large size is hard to park
